summary: PASS — Full end-to-end verification of the Khatabook-style Ledger redesign on mobile viewport 390x844 against https://logistics-ai-hub-18.preview.emergentagent.com (wired to remote backend https://logistics-hub-1349.emergent.host). All 11 scenarios in the review request passed: (1) Ledger tab renders totals widget with INR+THB Get/Give and Net position, top-receivables + top-payables sections render, search + role chips (all/customer/supplier/carrier) work; (2) FAB 'Add entry' opens bottom sheet with 'New party' row + 6 party rows; (3) Tapping a party (Somchai) navigates to /entry/new?party_id=... and party name renders at top; (4) Party detail from All Parties list shows both red 'You gave' and green 'You got' bottom action buttons; (5) Tapping 'You got' navigates with kind=got, Save button computed background = rgb(52,211,153) = colors.ok (green) confirming preselection; (6) Toggling to 'You gave' updates preview to 'YOU WILL GET MORE BY +…' (danger red); (7) Filled amount=1, currency auto-defaulted to THB (party default), tapped Save — POST /api/ledger/entries returned 200 with entry id 80ba60e8-ac65-4fc4-800a-43d57bab2fa8, navigated back to /ledger; (8) CLEANUP — DELETE /api/ledger/entries/80ba60e8-ac65-4fc4-800a-43d57bab2fa8 returned status 200, live data restored; (9) Zero page errors, zero console errors, no red-box overlay observed during the entire flow; (10) All new testIDs verified present: ledger-totals, top-receivables, top-payables, ledger-parties-search, ledger-role-{all,customer,supplier,carrier}, ledger-party-<id>, fab-add-entry, fab-new-party, fab-pick-party-<id>, party-you-gave-btn, party-you-got-btn, kind-gave, kind-got, entry-amount, entry-curr-INR, entry-curr-THB, entry-note, entry-date, save-entry-btn; (11) Old removed testIDs confirmed absent (ledger-tab-summary/get/give/entries count = 0).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/frontend/app/entry/new.tsx line 45 uses `useMemo` to sync `currency` state when party.data loads — this is semantically a side effect and should use `useEffect` instead of `useMemo`. It works today because React still runs the factory during render, but it's an anti-pattern and the existing eslint-disable comment already acknowledges the issue. Consider migrating to useEffect for clarity.

Minor: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ledger.tsx, `filtered.sort(...)` mutates the array reference returned from useMemo. Since `parties.data` array is passed through spread-free, this can mutate the underlying cached array. Consider `[...list].sort(...)` for safety.

Nit: FAB bottom offset `spacing.lg + 60` is hard-coded to clear the tab bar. Prefer `useBottomTabBarHeight()` from @react-navigation/bottom-tabs for correctness across devices with different safe-area/insets.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 11 scenarios passed, entry created + cleaned up successfully, no console errors

seed_data_creation: Created 1 test ledger entry (id 80ba60e8-ac65-4fc4-800a-43d57bab2fa8, THB 1.00 for party Somchai) and CLEANED UP successfully via DELETE (status 200). Live data is unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Khatabook-style ledger + entry-creation flow is fully functional. All testIDs are in place. The auto-refresh via useFocusEffect works — after Save, returning to /ledger showed no stale-data issues. Live remote backend accepts POST /api/ledger/entries with {party_id, date, description, debit, credit, currency, ref_type:'manual'} and DELETE /api/ledger/entries/{id} works. If a future regression is reported, first re-run the same flow on mobile 390x844 with the same testID selectors.
